episodes.title: The UFO Cult That Created Cognitive Dissonance Wasn't the Whole Story
episodes.description:
Dorothy Martin's 1954 UFO doomsday group is the case behind the 1956 book When Prophecy Fails and the term cognitive dissonance. Kelly's 2025 archival paper reopened the Chicago Tribune-era record, and Baggio and Amouroux's 2026 response concedes the covert observation and observer influence are serious problems even though they dispute deliberate fraud. The controlled test, Festinger and Carlsmith's 1959 $1/$20 experiment, long seemed like the cleaner proof; but Vaidis and colleagues' 2024 registered replication across 39 labs, 19 countries, 14 languages and 4,898 participants did not find the predicted attitude difference—only a partial effect. The archive dispute and the replication failure point to the same uncomfortable possibility: a bias-driven distortion may need no liar at all.

#CognitiveDissonance #WhenProphecyFails #CultsAndCoercion
